comparison.objective: Capture the distributed spring preload of a twelve-cell pack using a cross-key.
comparison.physical_skill: Compress a loose pressure plate with one arm while inserting a separate retaining key with the other.
comparison.success_condition: All twelve contacts and retained preload remain correct after both grippers withdraw.
comparison.reason: Both involve retaining a mechanical setting, but this record tests simultaneous distributed compression and key insertion. It does not test fine rotary tool work or iterative dynamic-response tuning. The record body does not expose separate numeric scoring tiers.
